title: Fix Better Auth Magic Link - Get Link from Convex Dashboard
description: Auth UI works but magic link appears in CONVEX DASHBOARD LOGS, not email. User needs to check dashboard.convex.dev for the link. Verify the full flow works end-to-end.

currentFiles: convex/betterAuth.ts - Better Auth config with magic link plugin
convex/http.ts - HTTP router for auth (created by Ralph)
src/routes/login.tsx - Login page UI (updated to point to Convex dashboard)
knownIssues: Magic link logs to Convex dashboard, NOT local terminal
User must check dashboard.convex.dev to find the magic link URL
technicalContext.userReport: User clicked 'Send Magic Link', UI showed success, but couldn't find email. Link is in Convex dashboard logs.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Start dev server: bun run dev
Enter etan@heyman.net and click 'Send Magic Link'
UI shows success message pointing to Convex dashboard
Open Convex dashboard (dashboard.convex.dev) and check logs
Find magic link URL in the logs
Copy magic link URL and navigate to it in browser
After clicking magic link, user is redirected to / and session is active
Navigate back to /login - shows 'Welcome, Admin!' with sign out button
Click 'Sign Out' - session is cleared, returns to login form
